    {
      "functional_intent": "Check if a host is reachable by executing a ping command with a user-supplied hostname.",
      "untrusted_data_sources": [
        "request.args.get(\"host\", \"\")"
      ],
      "violated_safety_invariant": "The host parameter is interpolated directly into a shell command string without sanitization or validation, allowing for command injection via shell metacharacters.",
      "cwe": "CWE-78",
      "title": "Command injection in ping command",
      "file": "app/diagnostics/network.py",
      "start_line": 3,
      "end_line": 3,
      "sink_expression": "os.system(f\"ping -c 1 {host}\")",
      "severity": "critical",
      "rationale": "The host variable is taken directly from the request arguments and passed to os.system. An attacker can provide a value like '127.0.0.1; cat /etc/passwd' to execute arbitrary commands on the host system.",
      "evidence_lines": [
        2,
        3
      ],
      "exploitability": "direct"
    }
  ]
}
